headline: 🪱 Tensorlake npm release poisoned with Shai-Hulud via trusted pipeline, 🤖 PoeLLM botnet mines 3,400+ AI servers, 🚔 ShinyHunters leader detained and cooperating with FBI, 🌐 Google cert forgeries traced to hijacked .gh/.sl/.as registries, ⚖️ MonsterCloud CEO charged over secret ransom payments, 🏥 Oracle Health breach climbs to ~20 million
summary: Supply chain and AI infrastructure define the day: the Shai-Hulud worm returned through a validly-signed Tensorlake npm release, the PoeLLM botnet mined over 3,400 exposed AI servers, and yesterday's counterfeit Google certificates were traced to compromised ccTLD registries.
